**KJAK01*** is a medical procedure code designating laparoscopic drainage of the abdominal cavity. It serves as a technical data point within the Danish healthcare system to track, analyze, and evaluate acute surgical interventions. 

The code is primarily significant for its inclusion in the population definition of the [[akut-kirurgi-databasen|Akut Kirurgi Databasen]] (Acute Surgery Database). This inclusion represents a methodological expansion of the database's tracked population, designed to ensure complete and accurate coverage of all relevant acute surgical procedures [^src1]. Specifically, the database's population definition was expanded to incorporate KJAK01*, alongside the codes KJAK03* and KJAK04*, because these procedures are actively used in the treatment of relevant patients at certain hospitals [^src1]. 

This technical update is part of a broader, ongoing narrative regarding quality development in Danish acute surgery. The continuous refinement of the database involves methodological adjustments to data sources and population definitions to better support quality indicators—such as antibiotic administration timing (Indikator 1) and 90-day mortality (Indikator 10). Through collaboration with organizations like the Danish Healthcare Quality Programme (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut) and LKT Akutkirurgi, these standardized updates ensure that the data accurately reflects clinical realities and supports national healthcare reforms.
